questions.question: Express 3x+1x2−x−6 in partial fractions.
options: 1x−3 + 2x+2
2x−3 + 1x+2
3x−3 + 5x+2
1x−2 + 2x+3
questions.explanation: Factor: x2−x−6=(x−3)(x+2). Let 3x+1(x−3)(x+2) = Ax−3 + Bx+2. Then 3x+1=A(x+2)+B(x−3). x=3: 10=5A⇒A=2. x=−2: −5=−5B⇒B=1. So 2x−3 + 1x+2.

questions.question: Decompose 20x2−4 into partial fractions.
options: 5x−2 − 5x+2
5x−2 + 5x+2
2x−2 − 3x+2
1x−2 + 2x+2
questions.explanation: Factor: x2−4=(x−2)(x+2). Let 20(x−2)(x+2) = Ax−2 + Bx+2. Then 20=A(x+2)+B(x−2). x=2: 20=4A⇒A=5. x=−2: 20=−4B⇒B=−5. So 5x−2 − 5x+2.

questions.question: Express 2x+10(x−1)(x+3) as partial fractions.
options: 3x−1 + −1x+3
2x−1 + 7x+3
1x−1 + 2x+3
2x−1 − 5x+3
questions.explanation: Let 2x+10(x−1)(x+3) = Ax−1 + Bx+3. 2x+10=A(x+3)+B(x−1). x=1: 12=4A⇒A=3. x=−3: 4=−4B⇒B=−1. So 3x−1 − 1x+3.

questions.question: Find the partial fraction decomposition of 2x2+5x+5(x+1)(x+2).
options: 1x+1 + 3x+2x+2
2x+1 + 2x+1x+2
3x+1 + x+2x+2
1x+1 + x+1x+2
questions.explanation: Denominator is (x+1)(x+2). Since numerator degree equals denominator, divide: 2x2+5x+5 = 2(x+1)(x+2) + (2x+1). So expression = 2 + 2x+1(x+1)(x+2). But option 2 is 2x+1 + 2x+1x+2. Check: 2x+1 + 2x+1x+2 = 2(x+2)+(2x+1)(x+1)(x+1)(x+2) = 2x+4+2x2+3x+1(x+1)(x+2) = 2x2+5x+5(x+1)(x+2).

questions.question: Decompose 3x2+6x+2x(x+1)(x+2) into partial fractions.
options: 1x + 1x+1 + 1x+2
xx + 2x+1 + 3x+2
2x + 3x+1 + 1x+2
1x + 2x+1 + 1x+2
questions.explanation: Let = Ax + Bx+1 + Cx+2. 3x2+6x+2=A(x+1)(x+2)+Bx(x+2)+Cx(x+1). x=0:2=2A⇒A=1. x=−1:−1=−B⇒B=1. x=−2:2=2C⇒C=1. So 1x + 1x+1 + 1x+2.

questions.question: Decompose 5x+6x2+3x+2 into partial fractions.
options: 2x+1 + 3x+2
1x+1 + 4x+2
5x+1 + 1x+2
3x+1 + 2x+2
questions.explanation: Factor: x2+3x+2=(x+1)(x+2). Let = Ax+1 + Bx+2. 5x+6=A(x+2)+B(x+1). x=−1:1=A⇒A=1. x=−2:−4=−B⇒B=4. So 1x+1 + 4x+2.

questions.question: Find the partial fraction of x3+3x2+4x+3(x+1)(x+2).
options: xx+1 + 1x+2
1x+1 + xx+2
x + 1x+1 + 1x+2
2x+1 + 3x+2
questions.explanation: Denominator (x+1)(x+2)=x2+3x+2. Divide: x3+3x2+4x+3 = x(x2+3x+2)+(2x+3). So = x + 2x+3(x+1)(x+2). 2x+3=A(x+2)+B(x+1). x=−1:1=A. x=−2:−1=−B⇒B=1. So x + 1x+1 + 1x+2.
